package.description: One terminal window, shared in real time between a human and an AI agent.

en-US.description: One terminal window, shared in real time between a human and an AI agent.
en-US.longDescription: BeamMeUp gives a human and an AI coding agent a single shared terminal window. The agent drives PowerShell, cmd, Git Bash, WSL, or SSH sessions through a command-line connector, while the human sees and can type into the exact same session, live. No MCP server to start ahead of time: the agent simply calls the beammeup executable, the same way it would call git or npm.
en-US.name: BeamMeUp
